ui.home_desc: Merge, split, rotate, compress and convert PDF files online for free. Includes an Uzbek Cyrillic and Latin converter with the new Ö Ğ Ş Ç alphabet.
ui.hero_title: Free PDF tools for everyday documents
ui.hero_lead: Merge, split, rotate and convert PDF files right in your browser. Nothing to install, and your files are deleted as soon as they are processed.

facts.p: Files are processed in memory and deleted right away. Nexuz never saves your documents.
Open a tool, add your files and download the result. No account needed.
Convert Uzbek text between Cyrillic, the current Latin and the new alphabet with Ö, Ğ, Ş and Ç.

ui.footer: © 2026 Nexuz. Files up to 25 MB, never stored. The first load can take up to a minute while the server wakes up.
ui.drop_many: or drag and drop them here
ui.drop_one: or drag and drop it here

ui.uz_opt_latin_new: New Latin: Ö Ğ Ş Ç
ui.uz_opt_latin: Current Latin: Oʻ Gʻ Sh Ch
ui.uz_placeholder: Paste or type Uzbek text here
ui.uz_err_long: The text is too long. The limit is 20,000 characters.
ui.uz_note_body: A law signed on 21 October 2026 replaces Oʻ, Gʻ, Sh and Ch with Ö, Ğ, Ş and Ç, and it takes effect on 22 April 2027. The letters ng are no longer a separate letter, and the apostrophe (tutuq belgisi) stays. Always check names and foreign words after converting.
ui.uz_example_text: O'zbekiston — Markaziy Osiyodagi go'zal mamlakat. Toshkent shahri chiroyli, g'alaba va choy haqida gaplashamiz.
ui.not_found_text: This page does not exist. Try the list of tools.

merge.name: Merge PDF
merge.desc: Combine several PDF files into one, in the order you choose.
merge.seo_desc: Merge PDF files into one document online for free. Add files, set the order and download. No sign-up, and files are never stored.
steps: Add two or more PDF files.
Use the arrows to put them in the right order.
Click “Merge PDF” and download the result.

split.name: Extract pages
split.desc: Keep only the pages you need from a PDF.
split.seo_title: Extract pages from a PDF online
split.seo_desc: Keep only the pages you need from a PDF file, for example 1-3,5. Free, fast and private.
steps: Add your PDF file.
Type the pages to keep, for example 1-3,5.
Click “Extract pages” and download the new PDF.

rotate.name: Rotate PDF
rotate.desc: Turn all pages of a PDF the right way up.
rotate.seo_desc: Rotate all pages of a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees online. Free and private.
steps: Add your PDF file.
Choose how to rotate the pages.
Click “Rotate PDF” and download the result.

compress.name: Compress PDF
compress.desc: Make a PDF smaller for email and uploads.
compress.seo_title: Compress PDF online, reduce file size
compress.seo_desc: Make a PDF smaller for email and uploads. Choose low, medium or high compression. Free, no sign-up.

level.label: Compression level
level.help: Works best on PDFs with photos or scans. Text-only PDFs are already small.

steps: Add your PDF file.
Choose a compression level. Medium is best for most files.
Click “Compress PDF” and download the smaller file.

pdf2img.name: PDF to images
pdf2img.desc: Save every page as an image. Up to 50 pages.
pdf2img.seo_title: Convert PDF to JPG or PNG images online
pdf2img.seo_desc: Save every page of a PDF as a PNG or JPG image and download them as a ZIP. Free and private.
steps: Add your PDF file (up to 50 pages).
Choose PNG for sharp images or JPG for smaller files.
Click “Convert to images” and download the ZIP.

img2pdf.name: Images to PDF
img2pdf.desc: Put JPG and PNG images into one PDF, one image per page.
img2pdf.seo_title: Convert JPG and PNG images to PDF online
img2pdf.seo_desc: Put JPG and PNG images into one PDF file, one image per page. Free, fast and private.
img2pdf.need: Add at least 1 JPG or PNG image.
steps: Add your JPG or PNG images.
Use the arrows to set the page order.
Click “Create PDF” and download the result.

watermark.name: Add watermark
watermark.desc: Stamp text across every page of a PDF.
watermark.seo_title: Add a watermark to a PDF online
watermark.seo_desc: Stamp a text watermark across every page of your PDF. Free, fast and private.

text.label: Watermark text
text.help: Latin letters and numbers. Marks like ğ or ş are not supported yet.

steps: Add your PDF file.
Type the watermark text.
Click “Add watermark” and download the result.

protect.name: Protect PDF
protect.desc: Lock a PDF with a password.
protect.seo_title: Protect a PDF with a password online
protect.seo_desc: Lock your PDF with a password (AES-256 encryption). Free, and your file and password are never stored.

password.label: Password
password.help: At least 4 characters. If you forget it, the file cannot be opened, and Nexuz cannot recover it.

steps: Add your PDF file.
Choose a password.
Click “Protect PDF” and download the locked file.

unlock.name: Unlock PDF
unlock.desc: Remove the password from your own PDF.
unlock.seo_desc: Remove the password from your own PDF file. You must know the password. Free and private.

password.label: Current password
password.help: You need to know the password. Nexuz cannot guess or break passwords.

steps: Add the protected PDF file.
Enter its current password.
Click “Unlock PDF” and download the file without a password.

uzbek.name: Uzbek alphabet converter
uzbek.desc: Convert text between Cyrillic, the current Latin and the new Ö Ğ Ş Ç alphabet.
uzbek.seo_title: Uzbek Cyrillic to Latin converter, new alphabet Ö Ğ Ş Ç
uzbek.seo_desc: Convert Uzbek text between Cyrillic, the current Latin and the new Ö, Ğ, Ş, Ç alphabet for free. The alphabet law takes effect on 22 April 2027.
steps: Paste or type your text on the left.
Choose the alphabet you want in “Convert to”.
Copy the result and check names and foreign words.
